= C5.1 — Real-AffineScript-emitted .wasm fixtures
:toc: preamble

Tracks https://github.com/hyperpolymath/typed-wasm/issues/35[typed-wasm#35] part 2.

The synthetic fixtures in `tests/cross_compat.rs` are hand-built with
`wasm_encoder`, and the expected verdicts are hand-traced. This
directory pairs four `.affine` sources with the **real** `.wasm`
output produced by `affinescript compile` so the post-codegen
verifier (`typed-wasm-verify`) is exercised against bytes a real
producer emits. The synthetic table remains the parity oracle; this
corpus is the cross-check.

== Fixture corpus

[cols="1,2,2,3"]
|===
| # | Source | Expected verdict | What it exercises

| 01 | `01_clean_linear.affine`
  | `Ok(())`
  | `@linear` consumed exactly once via let-rebind → `local.get 0` once
| 02 | `02_shared_borrow_twice.affine`
  | `Ok(())`
  | `ref Int` read twice in a single expression — allowed by SharedBorrow
| 03 | `03_partial_drop.affine`
  | `OwnershipError::LinearNotUsed` (sink), `LinearDroppedOnSomePath` (partial_drop)
  | `own Int` consumed in then-branch only; sink fn drops its param
| 04 | `04_excl_alias.affine`
  | `OwnershipError::ExclBorrowAliased`
  | `mut Int` read into two operands of one expression
|===

== Provenance

These bytes are reproducible from the paired `.affine` sources via:

[source,shell]
----
affinescript compile <source>.affine -o <source>.wasm
----

Captured 2026-05-27 against:

* `affinescript` HEAD `21edc159caee06a930cb7339b3e729ed5627b823`
* OCaml 4.14.2 (opam switch `affinescript`)
* `affinescript compile` default options (no `--wasm-gc`,
  no `--deno-esm`).

The `regenerate-fixtures.yml` CI workflow re-runs this compilation
on every PR that touches this directory, then compares the byte-for-byte
output. A drift in `affinescript`'s codegen surfaces immediately.

== Gaps deferred to follow-ups

. **Duplicate-Linear violation fixture.** The affinescript source-level
  borrow checker correctly rejects double-move; producing a real `.wasm`
  with a Linear param loaded twice from the same source needs either a
  source-level escape hatch (none exists today) or a hand-built fixture
  outside C5.1.
. **Multi-module fixtures** (clean cross-module Linear call, Linear-called-
  twice import, isolated vs shared memory pair). Need a multi-module
  build harness for `affinescript`; out of scope for the first C5.1
  drop. Tracked separately.

== Why these bytes, vendored?

The verifier crate's CI today does not build `affinescript`. Building
it would require provisioning OCaml + opam + the affinescript opam deps
on every PR — a heavy gate for what is fundamentally a parity check
against artefacts. Vendoring the `.wasm` bytes is the standard pattern
(see also `wasm-tools`, `wabt` test corpora) — fast, auditable, and the
regenerate workflow catches drift if affinescript's codegen ever
changes the wire shape.
